summary: The commit removes the safe-integer check in safeAdd, so a sum past 2^53-1 is returned as a silently rounded number instead of being reported as unsafe.

findings.explanation: Without `Number.isSafeInteger(sum)`, safeAdd(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, 2) returns 9007199254740992 — the same value as adding 1 — because JavaScript numbers lose integer precision past 2^53-1 without throwing.
